discrepancies: Every retained notice is byte-identical to its raw source physical line and the committed upstream legal resource. No wording was corrected. Clash of the Kingslayers literally has a comma before Copyright; Crypt of the Everflame has no separating punctuation before Copyright; Emerald Spire has a comma before © and names Nick Logue and James Sutter. Nearby The Emerald Spire Superdungeon at line 356 has different title, publisher and contributor wording; no equivalence is inferred. Line 350 literally reads Murder's Mark© (ASCII apostrophe, no space before ©); line 351 reads Murder’s Mark © (curly apostrophe, a space before ©). Their reconciliation is held independently while both lines remain verbatim and distinct. Plunder & Peril uses Paizo Inc. rather than Paizo Publishing, LLC. Copyright years, contributor names, © versus Copyright, periods/semicolons after LLC and all other punctuation are retained exactly. These are source readings, not inferred corrections. No printed verification or complete book chain is established.
